solutions.problem-01: function calculateScore(fieldGoals, threePointers, freeThrows) { return fieldGoals * 2 + threePointers * 3 + freeThrows; }
solutions.problem-04: function calculatePaintCost(red, blue, yellow) { return red * 12 + blue * 15 + yellow * 10; }
solutions.problem-05: function countTreasure(gold, silver, copper) { return gold * 10000 + silver * 100 + copper; }
solutions.problem-08: function rectangleArea(width, height) { return width * height; }
solutions.problem-09: function ticketTotal(adults, children) { return adults * 20 + children * 10; }
solutions.problem-11: function averageSpeed(distance, time) { return distance / time; }
solutions.problem-12: function energyUsed(watts, hours) { return watts * hours; }
solutions.problem-14: function pagesRead(pagesPerDay, days) { return pagesPerDay * days; }
solutions.problem-15: function totalSavings(weekly, weeks) { return weekly * weeks; }
solutions.problem-16: function animalLegs(chickens, cows) { return chickens * 2 + cows * 4; }
solutions.problem-17: function fuelNeeded(distance, efficiency) { return distance / efficiency; }
solutions.problem-18: function salePrice(price, discountPercent) { return price * (1 - discountPercent / 100); }
solutions.problem-19: function numberAverage(numbers) { return numbers.reduce((sum, number) => sum + number, 0) / numbers.length; }
solutions.problem-20: function movieMinutes(hours, minutes) { return hours * 60 + minutes; }
solutions.problem-22: function shippingCost(weight, rate, baseFee) { return baseFee + weight * rate; }
solutions.problem-25: function timeInSeconds(hours, minutes, seconds) { return hours * 3600 + minutes * 60 + seconds; }
